ui_bugs.issue: On /admin the YandexMap component throws 'ymaps.Map is not a constructor', the dev error overlay covers the page AND the root React tree unmounts (document.body.innerText is empty). This makes the WHOLE admin panel — including the new 'Fab-бар' tab — unusable for testing. Likely cause: window.ymaps exists but ymaps.ready() must be awaited before calling new ymaps.Map (race condition between script loader and component mount). No error boundary is in place to isolate the failure.

rca of the issue: AdminPanel.js imports YandexMap which calls `new window.ymaps.Map(...)` inside a useEffect on mount. When the Yandex JS API hasn't finished initializing (window.ymaps is the loader stub, not the ready namespace), the constructor is undefined and a TypeError is thrown synchronously inside the effect. React surfaces this to the nearest ErrorBoundary — and since there is none, the entire AdminPanel unmounts, leaving body empty and the dev-overlay visible. Reproduction: navigate to /admin/login, log in as admin/admin123 — observe empty body + 'ymaps.Map is not a constructor' page error. Mitigation options: (1) call window.ymaps.ready(() => { ... }) before constructing the Map (Yandex Maps API best practice), (2) wrap <AdminMap> / <YandexMap> in a React ErrorBoundary so other admin tabs survive, (3) load the ymaps script with `&onload=...` callback or feature-detect `typeof ymaps.Map === 'function'` before calling new.
